reference_sql:
SELECT pr.promo_type, ROUND(AVG(t.n_products), 2) AS avg_products
FROM (
  -- one row per promotion with products
  SELECT promo_id, COUNT(*) AS n_products
  FROM promotion_products
  GROUP BY promo_id
) AS t
JOIN promotions pr ON pr.promo_id = t.promo_id
GROUP BY pr.promo_type
alternatives:
SELECT pr.promo_type, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT pp.promo_id), 2) AS avg_products
FROM promotion_products pp
JOIN promotions pr ON pr.promo_id = pp.promo_id
GROUP BY pr.promo_type

WITH promo_sizes AS (
  -- one row per promotion with products
  SELECT promo_id, COUNT(*) AS n_products
  FROM promotion_products
  GROUP BY promo_id
)
SELECT pr.promo_type, ROUND(AVG(s.n_products), 2) AS avg_products
FROM promo_sizes s
JOIN promotions pr ON pr.promo_id = s.promo_id
GROUP BY pr.promo_type

other_way.sql:
SELECT pr.promo_type, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT pp.promo_id), 2) AS avg_products
FROM promotion_products pp
JOIN promotions pr ON pr.promo_id = pp.promo_id
GROUP BY pr.promo_type
other_way.tradeoff: Dividing the pairs by the distinct promotions of each type gives the same average without an inner step.
